concerns.text: Spec requires Moran's I > 0.15 to 'trigger a re-fit with a Gaussian Process (GP) random effect using a Matérn covariance function.' T005 makes the GP a priori and T006 reduces Moran's I to a post-hoc flag with no re-fit path. No task implements the spec's adaptive re-fit behavior; the requirement is silently uncovered.

FR-003 and the ClimateVariable entity require an 'extreme_weather_index' (also in gamm_results.schema.yaml enum). T003 only says 'joins climate variables (... extreme weather index)' — no task derives this index from Daymet temperature/precipitation, so the FR-003 extreme-weather component has no implementing task.

US-1 Scenario 1 requires 'a minimum of 208 weeks of data per grid cell ... with phenology metrics calculated for at least [deferred]% of species-year combinations.' No task verifies or reports against this acceptance scenario, and T001's deviation memo covers only the data-source change, not the acceptance-scenario gap.

plan.md specifies src/config.py, src/data/, src/models/, src/cli/ etc., but every task builds under code/ (code/config.py, code/data/, code/cli/). The tasks do not cover the plan's declared project structure; an implementer following the plan and one following tasks.md produce different trees. Either the plan must be amended or tasks must match it.

concerns.location: plan.md:Constitution Check V / Phases 0.3, 1.5, 2.4, 3.4 vs tasks.md:Revision behavior
concerns.text: The plan explicitly maps Constitution Principle V to state-synchronization steps updating state/projects/PROJ-132-...yaml with artifact hashes after every phase. tasks.md declares state-file synchronization 'platform-owned' and removes it entirely, so no task performs the constitutionally required state updates. The constitution itself (Versioning Discipline) requires every research-stage artifact change to update this file — this is not a platform CI concern.

concerns.location: constitution.md:Principle VII / Reproducibility Requirements vs tasks.md (all tasks)
concerns.text: The constitution requires a pinned requirements.txt (or pyproject.toml) at projects/PROJ-132-.../code/ and pinned exact package versions. No task creates or maintains a dependency-pinning file; T001 creates config.py but not requirements.txt.

The plan's Data Access Strategy and Complexity Tracking mandate file-based locking via filelock (data/.pipeline.lock, src/utils/locks.py). No task implements or covers the locking mechanism; the plan element is uncovered.

T005 claims results conform to both gamm_results.schema.yaml (p_value_fdr, model_aic, gp_included, additionalProperties:false) and output.schema.yaml (fdr_q_value, aic, r_squared, additionalProperties:false). The two contracts are mutually exclusive; the coverage claim is unsatisfiable as written and one contract reference must be dropped or the contracts reconciled.

US-2's independent test requires synthetic-calibration recovery 'within a 5% tolerance'; T005's test_gamm_single_species.py only says 'within tolerance' without pinning the 5% figure, weakening the spec's verification criterion.
